comparisons.peer_topic: Independent Oversight of Compliance and Operational Risk
comparisons.peer_summary: Global Compliance and Operational Risk teams independently assess risks, monitor activities, and evaluate adherence to laws and regulations. Corporate Audit provides independent validation through testing. Oversight is provided by the Board through its Audit Committee and the Executive Risk Committee (ERC), with requirements for reporting set by Enterprise Policy documents.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America utilize dedicated second-line functions (Operational Risk and Compliance teams) to independently monitor and test controls, aiming to identify heightened risk areas and ensure adherence to laws. JPM specifically notes that risk assessment results drive this independent monitoring to test control effectiveness within Lines of Business (LOBs) and Corporate. Similarly, Bank of America’s Global Compliance and Operational Risk teams independently assess risks and monitor activities to evaluate adherence to applicable Laws, Rules, and Regulations (LRRs), while Corporate Audit provides separate independent validation through testing.

sentences.text: The results of risk assessments performed by Operational Risk and Compliance are used in connection with their independent monitoring and testing compliance of the LOBs and Corporate with laws, rules and regulations.
Through monitoring and testing, Operational Risk and Compliance independently identify areas of heightened operational risk and tests the effectiveness of controls within the LOBs and Corporate.

Global Compliance and Operational Risk teams independently assess compliance and operational risk, monitor business activities and processes and evaluate FLUs and control functions for adherence to applicable LRRs, including identifying issues and risks, and reporting on the state of the control environment.
Corporate Audit provides an independent assessment and validation through testing of key compliance and operational risk processes and controls across the Corporation.

comparisons.peer_summary: Each Citi operating segment must implement operational risk management processes including risk assessment, control design and testing, key indicator establishment, monitoring against risk appetite, and resource allocation for risk mitigation.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Citigroup mandate that operating segments implement specific operational risk management processes that include control design, testing, and monitoring. JPMorgan describes Operational Risk and Compliance using risk assessment results to independently monitor and test controls within LOBs to identify heightened operational risk. Citigroup requires each operating segment to implement processes consistent with its framework, specifically listing the design, execution, and testing of controls, as well as monitoring operational risk exposures against risk appetite.

comparisons.peer_summary: Scenario analysis results are used to monitor changes in operational risk and identify business lines with heightened exposure, while the firm also performs firmwide stress tests as described in the Overview and Structure of Risk Management section.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs use analytical results to identify business lines or segments with heightened operational risk exposure. JPMorgan’s Operational Risk and Compliance team independently identifies areas of heightened operational risk through monitoring and testing. Goldman Sachs uses results from scenario analyses to monitor changes in operational risk and determine business lines that may have heightened exposure.

The results from these scenario analyses are used to monitor changes in operational risk and to determine business lines that may have heightened exposure to operational risk.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Operational Risk Department and NFR CTIS provide independent oversight of operational risk, while NFR CTIS specifically oversees technology, cybersecurity, and compliance risks, and the Operational Risk Department oversees fraud and third-party risk management.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley employ dedicated departments to provide independent oversight and monitoring of operational risk. JPMorgan’s Operational Risk and Compliance teams independently monitor and test controls to identify heightened risks. Morgan Stanley’s Operational Risk Department and NFR CTIS provide independent oversight of operational risk and assess, measure, and monitor it against appetite.
